entities.name: PLMN-SEARCH substate
entities.description: A substate entered by the UE during automatic network selection mode when maximum allowed unsuccessful tracking area updates occur, or after tracking area update/service request rejection.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to update tracking area information with the network.

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Combined procedure for tracking area update along with other operations.

entities.name: Attach for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to attach for emergency services when selected cell cannot provide normal service.

entities.name: Attach for access to RLOS
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to attach for RLOS access when selected cell cannot provide normal service.

entities.name: Maximum allowed number of subsequently unsuccessful tracking area updating
entities.description: Condition where UE has performed maximum allowed unsuccessful tracking area updates.

entities.name: Tracking area update rejected by network
entities.description: Condition where network rejects tracking area update request.

entities.name: Service request rejected by network
entities.description: Condition where network rejects service request.

entities.name: Selected cell known not to be able to provide normal service
entities.description: Condition where selected cell cannot provide normal service.

entities.name: Reset tracking area updating attempt counter
entities.description: Action to reset the tracking area updating attempt counter when new PLMN is selected.

relations.description: Maximum unsuccessful TAU condition allows UE to enter PLMN-SEARCH substate.
TAU rejection condition allows UE to enter PLMN-SEARCH substate.
Service request rejection condition allows UE to enter PLMN-SEARCH substate.
When new PLMN is selected in PLMN-SEARCH substate, UE resets TAU attempt counter.
UE initiates tracking area updating procedure after new PLMN selection in PLMN-SEARCH substate.
UE initiates combined tracking area updating procedure after new PLMN selection in PLMN-SEARCH substate.
Cell unable to provide normal service condition may lead UE to detach locally and initiate attach for emergency bearer services.
Cell unable to provide normal service condition may lead UE to detach locally and initiate attach for RLOS access.
